name: elite-frontend-design
description: Design, implement, redesign, and QA distinctive responsive frontend experiences with profile-routed art direction and evidence-driven verification.

interface.longDescription: Design, implement, redesign, and verify polished frontend experiences. Routes each task to a focused set of art-direction, product-UI, reference-first, motion, immersive-experience, responsive, accessibility, and browser-QA workflows instead of applying one generic visual preset.
capabilities: Design and implement distinctive frontend interfaces
Distill reusable design intelligence from live reference sites and inspectable frontend source
Redesign existing product UI without discarding good architecture
Verify responsive, accessibility, interaction, and rendered visual quality
Proactively generate bespoke frontend images with connected image tools and motion video clips with real artifacts
defaultPrompt: Design and implement a polished frontend for this product.
Redesign this existing UI and verify it on desktop and mobile.
Audit this frontend for visual, responsive, accessibility, and interaction issues.
Study these reference sites and distill their transferable design intelligence before designing.
Design this media-rich UI and proactively create original images or suitable motion clips using available authorized tools, then integrate and verify real assets.
